slot_scores.name: earnings_definition
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Does the "total amount of money" at the end of the third year include the original 100,000 yuan principal, or only the profit generated above that initial capital?
slot_scores.rationale: Explicitly asks whether the objective measures total final wealth including principal or net profit, directly clarifying the definition of earnings.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only hidden slot H1 was P2 and was clarified before READY_TO_MODEL; no unresolved P0/P1 slots remained.

summary: The agent explicitly clarified the definition of earnings (total final wealth versus net profit) before modeling, which was the only hidden slot; stopping was appropriate.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
